shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Diagram table cards and floating canvas controls (light).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Entrances, presses, the trail drawing in.

motion.name: trail-draw
motion.purpose: Trail connectors and diagram path drawing in once per trail change.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: One primary action per region: Run, Row, Download.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--accent-fill, #c24a22); color: var(--on-accent, #fff); font: 500 13px/1 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #b4411b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #cdc9bf); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--panel, #fff); color: var(--fg, #17181a); font: 500 13px/1 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn:hover { border-color: var(--fg-subtle, #63676e); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #b4411b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Input
components.css: .ds-input { height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #cdc9bf); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--ground, #f7f6f2); color: var(--fg, #17181a); font: 400 13px Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; outline: 0; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--fg-subtle, #63676e); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--accent, #b4411b); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-tint, #f9e6dd); }

components.name: Relationship Trail
components.description: The followed foreign-key path in the context bar.
components.css: .ds-trail { display: flex; align-items: center; font: 500 13px Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-trail a { height: 28px; padding: 0 11px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--relation-faint, #bcdccf); background: var(--relation-tint, #dcf1e9); color: var(--relation, #0b7356); } .ds-trail a.cur { border-color: var(--accent-line, #e2a083); background: var(--accent-tint, #f9e6dd); color: var(--accent, #b4411b); } .ds-hop { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; margin: 0 6px; } .ds-hop small { font: 400 11px 'Geist Mono', monospace; color: var(--fg-subtle, #63676e); } .ds-hop i { width: 44px; height: 2px; background: var(--relation-line, #1d9e75); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.css: .ds-filter { height: 28px; padding: 0 8px 0 10px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--accent-line, #e2a083); background: var(--accent-tint, #f9e6dd); color: var(--fg, #17181a); font: 400 12px Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-filter b { font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Sidebar Row
components.description: A table in the tables sidebar; selected state shown.
components.css: .ds-row { height: 30px; padding: 0 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 7px; font: 400 13px Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--fg, #17181a); } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--sunk, #efede7); } .ds-row.sel { background: var(--accent-tint, #f9e6dd); font-weight: 600; } .ds-row .n { margin-left: auto; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--fg-subtle, #63676e); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.northStar: The schema is the map you walk
narrative.overview: An instrument for understanding a database: quiet neutral chrome, coral for where you are, teal for what is connected, one workspace with connected views.
keyCharacteristics: One workspace, views of the selected table
Tables sidebar led by linked tables

rules.name: The Two Meanings Rule
rules.body: Coral means you are here; teal means connected.

rules.name: The Quiet Chrome Rule
rules.body: Chrome surfaces are panel-coloured, never tinted.

dos: Do keep coral for the current table and primary actions
Do show what a key points to wherever it appears
Do keep text at 4.5:1 or better
donts: Don't split diagram and data into separate apps
Don't clip generated code in a drawer
